sets.title: Review like a senior engineer, without reading code
sets.pitch: Your AI changes 50 files and you can't tell what broke. Every change gets a pass or fail against one clear bar, and every review comment gets answered and fixed before it merges.
skills: safe-to-merge
Your pull request gets every review comment answered and fixed until it's safe to merge.
code-check
A pass or fail on every change before it ships, against one clear bar.
never-twice
Every review teaches your AI, so the same mistake never comes back.

sets.title: Your AI stops breaking things that already worked
sets.pitch: You fix one bug and two old features break. Every change gets tested by tapping through your app like a real user, with no mocks hiding the breakage.
skills: test-like-a-user
Tests that open the real screen, tap the real button and check what you'd see. No mocks of your own code.
bug-trap
Every bug gets a test that fails first, so it can't sneak back in.
dont-break-it
Your AI changes, checks and saves code so nothing half-done ships.
fix-it-for-real
It fixes the cause, not the symptom, and reuses what someone already solved.
click-everything
It clicks through every page of your web app and fixes what breaks.

sets.title: Change old code without breaking it
sets.pitch: You inherit a codebase nobody fully understands, and every change is a guess. Your AI maps it first, shows you what each change will break, and adds tests before it touches anything risky.
skills: learn-this-codebase
Ask anything about a codebase you've never seen, and get answers with the file and line.
blast-radius
See everything a change will break before it's made. Risky edits wait for your yes.
tests-for-old-code
Tests for code that never had any, each one run and passing before you see it.
audit-a-module
Find out whether to refactor, rewrite or leave a module alone, on one screen.
stay-in-the-lines
Your architecture stays the way you drew it, because every change gets checked against your rules.
plan-from-scratch
Starting fresh? An architect, a product lead and a security lead plan it, and show you where they disagree.
deploy-without-fear
Deploy on any day. It checks before and after, and tells you the moment to roll back.
